role: CoreLocation + CMAltimeter wrapper for workout GPS: requests When-In-Use auth, streams fixes with accuracy/jitter gates into a track and GPS distance, tracks pause steps, buffers barometric altitude samples and keeps a live elevation gain/loss estimate; forwards newest fix to AmbientLocationService.
types: WorkoutLocationManager: class (@Observable, @MainActor, NSObject) — workout GPS/barometer state
state: private: manager (CLLocationManager), altimeter (CMAltimeter), liveAltitudeReference, lastJitterLogAt, barometricStartOffset, lastRawBarometricAltitude, pausedAltitudeShift, trackSeededByRejectedFix
constants: accuracyThresholdMeters 65, minimumMovementMeters 3.5, accuracyNoiseMultiplier 1.5, minimumElevationChangeMeters 1.0 (unused), liveSustainedClimbThresholdMeters 3.0
toplevel: Header comment (lines 8-21) says the manager uses While-Using only with "no backgrounding trickery" and does not attempt background execution, but configureManagerForBackgroundTracking sets allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates=true (line 213). minimumElevationChangeMeters (line 89) is declared and never used; barometricStartOffset is written (lines 287, 315) and never read anywhere in the repo. Created lazily by WorkoutRecorder.location (WorkoutRecorder.swift:156).

flags.text: File header says While-Using only, no background execution beyond the natural while-using lifetime, while startTracking enables allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates and the background indicator.
minimumElevationChangeMeters (1.0) is never referenced and barometricStartOffset is written but never read (grep across repo), so their doc comments describe behaviour that does not exist.

units.does: didSet of isPaused: when it flips from true to false (resume) inserts track.count into trackPauses.gaps so the next step (spanning the pause) contributes no time. Set by WorkoutSessionLifecycle.pause/resume (WorkoutRecorder+Start.swift:735,747), resetState and startIfAuthorizedWhileWaiting.

branches.cond: oldValue true and new value false
branches.effect: inserts current track.count into trackPauses.gaps; otherwise nothing

units.does: Initialises: copies manager.authorizationStatus, sets itself as CLLocationManager delegate, bestForNavigation accuracy, no distance filter, activityType .fitness, pausesLocationUpdatesAutomatically=false.
Calls requestWhenInUseAuthorization only when status is .notDetermined; no-op otherwise.

branches.effect: requests When-In-Use authorization
does nothing; a denied user gets no prompt and no feedback

units.does: If authorized: clears startsWhenAuthorized, wipes all state (resetState, which also clears isPaused), sets isTracking, configures background location, startUpdatingLocation and starts barometric updates, with step debug logs. If not authorized: sets startsWhenAuthorized only when status is .notDetermined, requests auth and returns (denied/restricted silently records no GPS). Called deferred from WorkoutSessionLifecycle.deferLocationTrackingStart (WorkoutRecorder+Start.swift:501) and from startIfAuthorizedWhileWaiting.

branches.effect: records whether to start after the prompt (only if notDetermined), requests auth, returns without tracking; otherwise proceeds to reset and start

flags.text: startTracking runs from a deferred Task after the phase is already .recording and unconditionally resetState() (isPaused=false). A pause issued between workout start and the deferred task running leaves the location manager unpaused while the lifecycle is paused, so fixes in that window count as workout distance.

units.does: Sets allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates=true, pausesLocationUpdatesAutomatically=false and showsBackgroundLocationIndicator=true, logging each step (watchdog-hang breadcrumbs).

Clears startsWhenAuthorized, stops location updates and altimeter updates, sets isTracking false; keeps track/distance for the caller to persist. Called by WorkoutRecorder stop (WorkoutRecorder+Stop.swift:129).

Sets barometerAvailable from CMAltimeter.isRelativeAltitudeAvailable; if available starts relative-altitude updates on the main queue whose handler forwards relativeAltitude to ingestBarometricAltitude.

branches.effect: logs GPS-altitude fallback and returns
handler drops the update silently; otherwise ingests

units.does: CMAltimeter handler body: computes step from the previous raw reading; while paused accumulates the step into pausedAltitudeShift and returns; otherwise appends (Date(), raw-pausedAltitudeShift) to barometricSamples and advances the live accumulator. Timestamps use Date() at delivery, not the altimeter sample timestamp.
units.entry: CMAltimeter relative-altitude callback on main queue (via closure at line 254)

branches.effect: ?? uses raw itself so first step is 0
adds step to pausedAltitudeShift and returns without storing a sample; otherwise stores and advances

units.does: Deadband accumulator: first sample seeds liveAltitudeReference (and barometricStartOffset); later, once |current-reference| >= 3 m, the whole move is added to elevationGainMeters or elevationLossMeters and reference moves to current.

branches.effect: seeds reference/start offset and returns
returns without banking
adds to gain; else adds -move to loss

units.does: Public wipe of all accumulated state via resetState. Called by resetRecorderStateAfterStop (WorkoutRecorder+Stop.swift:233).

Clears currentLocation, distance, pause flag (didSet may insert a gap into the old trackPauses first), trackPauses, elevation gain/loss, barometric references/shift/buffer, jitter log time, track and the seeded flag.

Per-fix ingest: records lastHorizontalAccuracy; unusable fixes only seed an empty track; the first usable fix after a rejected seed replaces the track; otherwise credits movement from the previous fix (or appends the first fix); finally sets currentLocation (even when movement was rejected as jitter).

branches.effect: seedTrackIfEmpty and return

branches.cond: track holds only a rejected seed fix
branches.effect: track = [location], clears seed flag (no distance credited)
creditMovement from it; else (empty track) appends the fix

flags.text: ingest has no isTracking check and fixes arrive via an unstructured MainActor Task per delegate callback (line 444); a batch delivered just before stopTracking() is ingested after it, appending to track/distanceMeters after the workout's stop (finalize reads location.track/distance after stopTracking, WorkoutRecorder+Stop.swift:129) or after reset(), leaving a stale currentLocation/track.

units.does: True when 0 < horizontalAccuracy <= threshold (65 m); otherwise logs the dropped fix and returns false.

branches.effect: logs and returns false; otherwise true

units.does: Appends a rejected fix as a placeholder only when the track is empty, marks trackSeededByRejectedFix and sets currentLocation.

branches.effect: returns without change

units.does: Credits a step only when delta >= 3.5 m and >= noise floor (min(1.5x worst accuracy, 20 m)); rejected steps are logged and not appended. Accepted steps while paused mark the index in trackPauses.paused (no distance); otherwise add to distanceMeters and the GPS elevation fallback; the fix is appended either way.

branches.effect: logs jitter reject and returns (fix not appended)
marks step index as paused (route extends, no distance); otherwise adds distance and GPS elevation fallback

units.does: Returns min(max(current.accuracy, previous.accuracy) x multiplier, 20 m).
Only when no barometer: adds GPS altitude delta to gain/loss when |delta| >= 5 m.

branches.effect: returns (barometer owns gain/loss)
returns
adds to gain; else to loss

units.does: Logs a jitter rejection at most once per 60 s of fix time.

branches.effect: returns without logging; otherwise records time and logs

units.does: CLLocationManagerDelegate didUpdateLocations: hops to MainActor, ingests every fix in order, then forwards the last fix to AppDependencies.current.location.ambientLocationService.record.

branches.effect: ingest(location:)
records last fix in ambient service; otherwise nothing

units.does: CLLocationManagerDelegate auth change: on MainActor stores the new status and calls startIfAuthorizedWhileWaiting.
units.entry: CoreLocation delegate callback locationManagerDidChangeAuthorization (also fires once on delegate assignment)

units.does: If a workout asked to track before the prompt was answered and status is now decided: clears the request; when authorized, starts tracking and restores the previous isPaused value (startTracking resets it).

branches.cond: no pending request or still notDetermined
branches.effect: returns
drops the request silently; otherwise starts tracking

units.does: True for .authorizedWhenInUse or .authorizedAlways.
CLLocationManagerDelegate didFailWithError: ignores every error (including kCLErrorDenied), so GPS distance just stops advancing with no user signal.

flags.text: All location errors are discarded with no log, so a revoked permission or persistent failure mid-workout leaves no trace in diagnostics.
